title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_delitto_con_inganno_by_franco_matteucci_xpw6r (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_delitto_con_inganno_by_franco_matteucci_xpw6r' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted computer. Removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software, as the attacker may have established persistent control over the system.
